name: Paladin Sarissa
source:
Sarissa is an Independent Paladin serving the Church of the Divine in the Eastern provinces. She is called Carnifex, old tongue for Executioner. Considered the most powerful paladin the Church has seen in a thousand years, Sarissa's only concern is fulfilling a personal oath. Despite a rocky start, the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url] and Sarissa are finding a strong attraction towards each other.
